summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for pytest fixture management in conftest.py. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which cover Flink DataStreams, Next.js static assets, AgentOps monitoring, VCR cassettes, and metrics recording). The peer_candidates (VCR, metrics, AgentOps) are related testing/instrumentation skills but operate at different layers and address different concerns. This candidate establishes reusable test infrastructure via pytest fixtures—a foundational testing pattern not yet represented in the registry.
